comments.author: @straight_level_cruising
comments.text: Can this tool generate patent claims starting from the patent specification? Where the specification includes at least 20 embodiments on top of the primary invention (just to give a number). The problem is writing claims, not writing specification, most people can write a specification, be it a simple story. The use is to write a specification and have the program generate the claims from it.

comments.author: @johnaddison5927
comments.text: Jack - no disrespect to the IP Lawyers out there but I think the concept of "PatentPal" is better suited for the small inventors out there. IP Lawyers may or may not find patentpal useful as it helps save their time and maybe improve quality of drafting. Small inventors will REALLY find patentpal useful as it saves them signficant money spent on IP Lawyers which are typically 400$ an hour.
